responsibility: Exposes the solver inspection API by re-exporting shared inspect data structures, wiring in the internal proof-tree builder for the `solve` module, and re-exporting canonical-state instantiation needed to replay recorded solver states.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is only the inspection-facing facade. Its code is mostly re-exports plus wiring of the internal proof-tree builder and canonical-state instantiation, so it does not implement solver evaluation, candidate assembly, top-level goal computation, or `NormalizesTo` normalization logic.
